rationale: This is a near-mechanical splice of two already-tested archive winners (Lagged Intangible Margin Inflection's delta-margin leg with Internal Intangibles over Goodwill Profit's internal-minus-goodwill leg), so it is a cosmetic recombination rather than a new mechanism, and the goodwill subtraction is unlikely to change the second leg's cross-sectional ranking much.

Structurally identical to the archive's Durable Intangible Profitability (intensity × 3yr-MA profitability × negative volatility) with only the volatility target swapped from profitability to spend intensity, and that parent already showed a weak FF5 alpha (t=1.40), so the variant is cosmetic and unlikely to fix the portfolio-side failure.

The gross-to-operating dropthrough leg is the level version of the archive's already-tested Gross-to-Operating Intangible Conversion (and is close to Productive Intangible Overhead's oibdp/xsga), while the second leg is copied verbatim from Internal Intangibles over Goodwill Profit, making this a recombination of three prior signals with no new economic content.

The change-in-asset-turnover leg is a genuinely new construct in this archive and is economically coherent when paired with cash margin, though the intangible adjustment to the denominator is likely immaterial to the ranking and the margin × turnover product risks being a restatement of a DuPont ROA improvement.

This is the archive's Lagged Intangible Margin Inflection with the profitability delta re-scaled from sales to a lightly intangible-adjusted asset base — a denominator tweak, not a substantively different mechanism — and the INTERACTION_TYPE is mislabeled as "ratio" when the expression is a multiplicative composite.

Internally consistent (high signal = deteriorating margins plus heavy goodwill, expected negative) and a genuinely new short-side conditional direction for this archive, though the COALESCE(gdwl,0) mass of zero-goodwill firms will pile up at the bottom of the product and may make the long leg an uninformative mixture.
